services.title: Our Services
services.eyebrow: What we deliver · From Ninja to Yoda

items.title: Automation Ninja
items.description: We find out where your time disappears, and automate away the biggest time sink. With AI we can now build simple internal software, connect data sources and automate processes far faster than before, it is only a matter of finding where to apply it. We map your workflow, produce a prioritised list of time sinks, and put the first automation into production quickly.

items.title: Innovation Crew
items.description: Have an idea but no technical team to build it? We take on the entire technical delivery, from electronics and hardware to backend, frontend and operations, and hand you a finished product. We have done this before, from field sensors to cloud solutions handling real-time data, with a small crew carrying the whole technical responsibility itself.

items.title: Reinforcements
items.description: Sometimes you need an expert in something you have no use for full time, other times simply more hands: one developer for three weeks, or several people over six months. We lend you specialists in development, cloud, electronics and project management, hourly and with no commitment beyond what you actually need. Billed by the hour, with regular progress updates.

items.title: Advisory
items.description: Are you adopting AI in your operations, assessing the tech stack of a company before you invest, or getting a product through CE certification? Those are three of the questions we have been asked. Advisory is what you buy when you need no code, no schematics and no project management from us, only the judgement. We tell you what we would have done ourselves, because we have been through it before.

about.title: About Us
about.lead: Purpeon Digital is an innovative consultancy firm, and our consultants have many years of experience helping businesses navigate the complexity of modern technology.
about.description1: Extensive experience from various industries, both public and private sector, gives us unique insight into the challenges businesses face today.
about.description2: With expertise spanning both IT and hardware, we are in a unique position to offer comprehensive technology solutions.
about.description3: The name Purpeon Digital originates from the flower foxglove (Digitalis purpurea), which was also the county flower of Sogn og Fjordane, thus reflecting our local connection and identity.

team.lede: We're a small, seasoned team with long experience from both large enterprises and early-stage startups. Together we cover software, infrastructure, and electronics, and we take on both short engagements and longer collaborations.

members.name: Dagfinn Olav Marsfjell Reiakvam
members.bio: Dagfinn is our managing director and has long experience as an electronics engineer, with deep expertise in embedded systems and IoT solutions. He has worked on everything from prototyping to mass production, and has a good handle on both hardware and software.

members.name: Finn Michael "Fimmi" Halvorsen
members.bio: Fimmi holds an MSc in communications technology and has long experience as a full-stack developer. He has worked on everything from small projects to large enterprise solutions, and has a solid grasp of modern technology.

members.name: Kjell Inge Rotnes
members.bio: Kjell Inge is a co-owner and has long experience as a software developer and architect, with deep expertise in scalable solutions and cloud infrastructure.

members.name: Roger Karlsen
members.bio: Roger is a co-owner of Purpeon and has experience as a software developer in the banking and energy sectors. He was an early adopter of AI and already has several years of experience with AI development and autonomous agents.

references.lede: Our clients work in everything from aquaculture technology in Belgium to electrical and automation on the Norwegian west coast. Here are some of the ones we work closely with.

clients.name: Vision3F
clients.description: Vision3F develops V-Tag, a system that monitors fish health in salmon farming in real time. Purpeon contributes software development and cloud infrastructure to the project.

clients.name: Sætren
clients.description: Sætren delivers electrical and automation services, from installations in buildings to industrial automation. Purpeon contributes IoT hardware design, integration and cloud solutions to one of their innovation projects.
